omwCili.evidence: OMW/CILI provides interlingual lexical synset identifiers and OMW 2.0 publishes versioned archives with checksums.
limitations: modified compositions are not proven by a head synset
coverage and language codes vary by resource

wikidata.evidence: Wikidata supplies stable Q identifiers with multilingual labels, aliases, descriptions, and statements.
limitations: labels and aliases are not unique
live data requires a pinned revision or dump for reproducibility

conceptNet.reason: language-scoped relatedness and association edges do not establish a universal exact identity

architectures.structuredComposition: converges equivalent head/modifier proposals but does not prove external synonymy
architectures.omwExact: resolves one exact lemma/POS to one ILI; ambiguous or modified cases fail closed
architectures.stableEntityExact: resolves one prevalidated stable entity ID; duplicate IDs deduplicate, disagreements remain ambiguous
architectures.cascade: first exact result is accepted only when later providers do not disagree

interpretation: The fixture validates deterministic provider policy, not real-corpus coverage. A pinned OMW/CILI snapshot must be supplied by an application before making empirical language-coverage claims.
